editorialNotes: This record corresponds to the current 2:58 video and replaces the earlier recorded rehearsal; Git history retains that prior public record.
Ten actual model calls completed with no fallback in this recorded run; this is not a guarantee for other investigations.
The broad rollback B restored the original journeys but failed the additional Hamburg IPv6 challenge.
G8 remains pending in immutable preapproval candidate gates; the separate approval and applied outcome record the completed decision.
Approval was performed by browser automation under explicit owner instruction. Credentials, full approval tokens and signing material are omitted.
Session-continuity results are model-derived; tripled probe concurrency does not model production traffic volume.
Topology and customer counts are synthetic; the lab uses real FRR/CoreDNS/nginx protocol services.
Waiting and review time are shortened in the video. Its duration is not a repair-time benchmark.
This is one protocol-lab rehearsal, not a production reliability or productivity measurement.
